title: MBDCap-Seq/MethylCap-Seq/MBD-Seq/MBDCap/MiGS
scope: Illumina explanatory family schematic, with primary-supported implementation distinctions. The drawing runs from methylated genomic DNA through extraction, fragmentation (labelled Fractionate), biotinylated-MBD capture on streptavidin magnetic beads, increasing-salt elution and DNA purification to the final DNA icon; the right-edge DNA label is partly clipped. The leftmost nucleosome cartoon is descriptive, without a transfer arrow or a separate assay branch. Library preparation and sequencing are text-supported interfaces, represented below only for the identified MethylCap-Seq, MiGS and MBDCap-Seq implementations. These are alternative method routes from fragmented DNA, never simultaneous inputs or pooled libraries. MBD-Seq and MBDCap remain catalogue group labels whose cited array implementations do not establish the depicted sequencing workflow. No historical priority, universal alias equivalence or cross-method interchangeability is asserted.

One disadvantage of MiGS, as compared to bisulfite sequencing, is that the description of methylation is not at single base pair resolution; rather, the resolution depends on the fragment size of the sonicated DNA. operations.label: Methylated-DNA capture (MethylCap): GST-linked isolation and salt recovery
operations.description: For the Bock comparison implementation, bind sonicated DNA using His6-GST-MBD and recover the complexes with glutathione magnetic beads, then release DNA in increasing-salt eluates and purify the collected fractions. operations.information_effect: Selection preserves genomic sequence while redistributing representation by methylated-CpG affinity and density; the separate eluates retain a fraction association before sequencing.

operations.label: Isolation of methylated DNA by recombinant MBD (MiGS)
operations.description: Select methylated sheared DNA with His-tagged MBD2_MBD coupled through anti-His antibody to protein-G magnetic beads. Release the captured DNA using the reported SDS/proteinase-K elution and purify it. The input is free fragmented DNA and the output is free enriched DNA. This local isolation route replaces the depicted biotin capture and salt-gradient release for MiGS.
operations.mechanism: MBD2_MBD recognizes methylated CpGs; antibody recognizes the protein tag. Protein G provides the antibody-to-bead interface. The antibody is not a methylcytosine-recognition reagent.
operations.information_effect: Enrichment favors densely methylated DNA, whose genomic sequence is retained for sequencing; it does not convert methylated bases into a distinct sequence code.

method_scopes.rationale: MethylCap, Methyl-Cap and MethylCap-seq are supported naming forms in the cited sources. The protocol abstract (PMID 20542119; abstract only) identifies MeCP2 MBD and salt-gradient fractionation; the comparison full text (PMID 20852634) specifies His6-GST-MBD and glutathione magnetic beads. Its selected-route operations are the paper-authored GST route, not o_capture_biotin. The diagram's salt-fractionation concept is consistent at a schematic level, but its attachment chemistry is different. No claim that all MethylCap variants share the same immobilization is made.

evidence.quote: The approach consists of the capture of methylated DNA using the MBD domain of MeCP2, and subsequent next-generation sequencing of eluted DNA.

unknowns.question: Which exact implementation supplied the figure's biotinylated-MBD/streptavidin-bead capture combined with increasing-salt elution? The diagram establishes this architecture, but the inspected primary papers do not identify one listed implementation with both details. A figure attribution or the exact depicted protocol would resolve the mapping; it does not block reading the family schematic.

Did the de Assis MethylMiner implementation use the diagram's attachment chemistry and separately retained increasing-salt fractions? The inspected methods paragraph does not say; the experiment's referenced kit/protocol version or supplementary methods would be needed before assigning those exact diagram operations.

Which exact sequencing protocols are intended by the catalogue labels MBD-Seq and MBDCap? The supplied associated papers establish MBD or MIRA enrichment with array readout, not those complete sequencing implementations. A primary sequencing protocol explicitly tied to each label is required to resolve this name-to-workflow question.
